name: WHO SMART Guidelines smart-base toolchain
description: A checkout of WorldHealthOrganization/smart-base, whose input/scripts/ carries the DAK extractors, generators and XSLT transforms. Loaded from, never vendored: the scripts are invoked by the DAK repositories' own GitHub Actions, so smart-base stays their authoritative home and this platform depends on it rather than copying it. Resolved from SMART_BASE_HOME, defaulting to /opt/smart-base.
